message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities. Here’s how: | Step | What to do | Where to go / Who to contact | |------|------------|------------------------------| | **1** | **Gather details** – note the date, time, location, and description of the noise. If possible, record a short audio clip (many complaints require proof). | — | | **2** | **File online** – use the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal.
• Visit the official website:
• Click “Submit a Complaint” → “Noise” → fill out the form. | City of Atlanta 311 portal | | **3** | **Call 311** – if you prefer phone or need help filling the form.
• Phone: 404‑656‑4000 (Atlanta Police Department)
• Hours: 24/7 for emergencies; 8 a.m.–5 p.m. weekdays for non‑emergencies. | Atlanta Police Department (Noise Enforcement Unit) | | **4** | **Email** – you can also send an email to the Noise Enforcement Unit.
• Email: noise@atlantaga.gov | Noise Enforcement Unit | | **5** | **Visit in person** – if you’re nearby, you can drop off a written complaint at the Atlanta Police Department’s Noise Enforcement Unit office.
• Address: 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30308 | Noise Enforcement Unit office | ### Quick reference | Contact | Phone | Email | Online | |---------|-------|-------|--------| | Atlanta Police Department – Noise Enforcement Unit | 404‑656‑4000 | noise@atlantaga.gov | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | City of Atlanta 311 | 404‑656‑4000 | — | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | ### Additional tips * **Decibel limits** – Atlanta’s noise ordinance sets limits of 70 dB during the day and 60 dB at night. If you’re unsure whether the noise violates the ordinance, the Noise Enforcement Unit can advise. * **Follow‑up** – After filing, you’ll receive a case number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up questions or to check status online. * **Legal resources** – If you need more detailed legal guidance on noise laws in Georgia, let me know and I can pull up relevant statutes or help you find a lawyer. Feel free to let me know if you’d like me to retrieve the specific noise ordinance text or any other legal documents related to noise complaints in Atlanta.
